HANGZHOU-ALIEXPRESS-PLATFORM-CHOICE.claim: In Hangzhou's first nationwide-mode case, an AliExpress representative said the platform can choose the return plan and convenient return port; airport logistics and customs jointly built the operating plan.

SHANDONG-POST-ALIEXPRESS-COORDINATION.claim: The Jinan flow was created by Shandong Post with local government, customs and AliExpress through a multi-party operating mechanism, with repeated practical drills around declaration, port clearance and multimodal logistics.

GUANGDONG-POST-9610-CLOSED-LOOP.claim: Guangdong Post's cross-border customs system integrates the customs public platform, China Post's 9610 system and partner customs brokers into a closed loop covering order/waybill/list/bill, arrival/departure and return declaration.

LIANDUO-ONE-STOP-CUSTOMS.claim: LianDoo currently offers one-stop 9610/9710/9810 port customs, tax, customs affairs and information-system execution rather than a neutral cross-port comparison market.

KUAZUN-NATIONWIDE-PORT-SYSTEM.claim: KuaZun currently supports 9610/9710/9810 full document workflows including returns and says it can connect to nationwide ports, Single Window/e-port/public-service systems; the public surface is workflow execution, not live cross-port route comparison.

XIXIAN-FULLCHAIN-RETURN.claim: Xi'an Airport New City says its supervised site, return warehouse and sorting infrastructure can provide full-chain reverse-logistics support to sellers nationwide, showing port-local integrated service capacity.

findings: The legal/policy option is genuine: an enterprise may choose an eligible return port based on cost/time.
Observed operating cases are not an open cross-port transaction rail. They are assembled by platform/logistics/site/customs coalitions.
At least one observed case identifies the ecommerce platform itself as the actor selecting the return plan and port.

Current 9610 software/customs providers expose multi-port workflow execution and system connectivity, but no current public source exposes a neutral live matrix of eligible-site availability, all-in cost, SLA and callable booking across ports.
The proposed operator asset would therefore require non-public partner rates/capacity/customs-operating conditions or recurring expert/broker coordination before a route can be resolved.
Absence of a public universal incumbent does not prove an unowned callable edge.

operator_control.reason: Actual execution/control is fragmented across platform, carrier, supervised site, broker and customs-specific operating relationships; independent operator control was not evidenced.

match_resolvability.reason: No stable public cross-port route attribute/quote/capacity surface was found; policy eligibility alone cannot resolve the best route.

action_gate_callability.reason: Operational cases required coordinated platform/logistics/customs setup; no independent repeatable booking/settlement rail across ports was evidenced.

recurring_missing_edge.reason: The public evidence proves new optionality and cost savings, but not a distinct missing matching edge rather than fragmented incumbent execution.
